pages.title: Mace of Horus
pages.text: Divine weapon blessed by the falcon god. Grants night vision when held and may blind attackers. Deals +50% damage to airborne foes.

pages.title: Serpent Staff
pages.text: Ancient staff that fires poisonous snake projectiles. Right-click to fire, sneak + right-click for targeted attack. Applies Poison II.

pages.title: Withered Staff
pages.text: Launches wither skulls when charged. A weapon of $(curse)dark power$() that should be used with caution.

pages.title: Ancient Pick
pages.text: Mystical pickaxe with a chance to preserve durability and grant haste when mining. Efficient for extended excavations.
